description: Header file defining the StandardCalculatorViewModel class for the calculator app, including properties, methods, and event handlers related to calculator state and UI interactions.

classes.name: StandardCalculatorViewModel
classes.description: Sealed ref class implementing the ViewModel for the standard calculator, managing properties, commands, and interactions.
